ns2:course.label: Mgmt of Innov and Technology
ns2:course.description: Course focuses on the strategic management of technology and innovation in organizations. It builds primarily on broad models of technological evolution and organizational change. Same as TMGT 367. Prerequisite: BADM 320 or concurrent enrollment in BADM 365.
